title: What If You Rode Humanity's Fastest Spacecraft Into the Sun's Atmosphere?

scenes.text: What if you rode the fastest machine ever built into the Sun's atmosphere?
NASA's Parker Solar Probe moves at about 430,000 miles per hour, faster than any human-made object has ever travelled.
Earth sits 93 million miles from the Sun. Parker closed in on it until the Sun filled its view.
On December 24, 2024, it reached about 3.8 million miles above the surface, closer than any craft before.
Out there, the corona can exceed one million degrees Fahrenheit, yet the heat shield only warms to about 1,800 degrees.
Behind that shield, instruments stay at comfortable room temperature. The hottest place you could fly is survivable, if you hide in the shadow.

description:
